paragraphs: The Charles Schwab Corporation is an American multinational financial services company. It offers banking, commercial banking, investing, and related services including consulting, and wealth management advisory services to both retail and institutional clients. One of the largest banks in the United States by assets, as of December 31, 2024, it had $10.10 trillion in client assets, 36.5 million active brokerage accounts, 5.4 million workplace retirement plan participant accounts, and 2.0 million banking accounts. It also offers a donor advised fund for clients seeking to donate securities. It was founded in San Francisco, California, and is headquartered in Westlake, Texas. It has over 380 branches, primarily in financial centers in the United States and the United Kingdom.

Founded as First Commander Corporation in 1971 and renamed to Charles Schwab & Co. in 1973, the company leveraged deregulation of the 1970s to pioneer discount sales of equity securities. After a flagship opening in Sacramento, California, the bank expanded into Seattle before the 1980s economic expansion financed the bank's investments in technology, automation, and digital record keeping. The first to offer round-clock order entry and quotation, it was purchased by Bank of America in 1983 for $55 million. Three years later, the profitability of the bank's no-charge mutual funds prompted the founder to buy his company back for $280 million.

people.name: Charles R. Schwab
people.title: Co-Chairman of the Board
people.bio: Mr. Schwab has been a director of CSC since its incorporation in 1986 and became Co-Chairman in 2022. He previously served as Chairman, Chief Executive Officer, and Co-Chief Executive Officer.
people.quote: Mr. Schwab has been a director of CSC since its incorporation in 1986.

people.name: Walter W. Bettinger II
people.title: Co-Chairman of the Board
people.bio: Mr. Bettinger has served on the board since 2008 and as Co-Chairman since 2022, and was Chief Executive Officer from 2008 through December 2024. He joined Schwab in 1995 through the acquisition of The Hampton Company, which he founded in 1983.
people.quote: Mr. Bettinger has served as a member of the board since 2008 and as Co-Chairman of the Board since 2022.

people.name: Richard A. Wurster
people.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Mr. Wurster has served as Chief Executive Officer and a director since January 2025 and as President since 2021. He joined Schwab in 2016 after working at Wellington Management and McKinsey & Company.
people.quote: Mr. Wurster has served as Chief Executive Officer and as a director of CSC since January 2025

people.name: Jonathan S. Beatty
people.title: Managing Director and Head of Advisor Services
people.bio: Mr. Beatty has served as Managing Director and Head of Advisor Services of CSC and CS&Co since 2024. He joined Schwab in 1997 and has held sales and leadership positions within Advisor Services.
people.quote: Mr. Beatty has been Managing Director and Head of Advisor Services of CSC and CS&Co since 2024.

people.name: Jonathan M. Craig
people.title: Managing Director and Head of Investor Services
people.bio: Mr. Craig has been Managing Director and Head of Investor Services and Marketing of CSC since 2022 and President of CS&Co since 2025. He joined Schwab in 2000 and previously served as Chief Marketing Officer and in other executive roles.
people.quote: Mr. Craig has been Managing Director and Head of Investor Services and Marketing of CSC since 2022 and President of CS&Co since 2025.

people.name: Dennis W. Howard
people.title: Managing Director, Chief Technology, Operations and Data Officer
people.bio: Mr. Howard has held his current role at CSC and CS&Co since January 2026, after serving as Chief Information Officer. He joined Schwab in 2014 after spending 12 years at Visa in information technology roles.
people.quote: Mr. Howard has been Managing Director, Chief Technology, Operations and Data Officer of CSC and CS&Co since January 2026.

people.name: Peter J. Morgan III
people.title: Managing Director, General Counsel, and Corporate Secretary
people.bio: Mr. Morgan has been Managing Director of CSC and CS&Co since 2022 and General Counsel and Corporate Secretary of CSC since 2019. He joined Schwab in 1999 and has served as General Counsel of CSB since 2009.
people.quote: Mr. Morgan has been Managing Director of CSC and CS&Co since 2022

people.name: Nigel J. Murtagh
people.title: Managing Director and Chief Risk Officer
people.bio: Mr. Murtagh has been Managing Director and Chief Risk Officer of CSC since 2022, following service as Executive Vice President and Chief Risk Officer from 2012 to 2022. He joined Schwab in 2000 and previously held chief credit officer roles.
people.quote: Mr. Murtagh has been Managing Director and Chief Risk Officer of CSC since 2022

people.name: Michael D. Verdeschi
people.title: Managing Director and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Mr. Verdeschi has served as Managing Director and Chief Financial Officer of CSC and CS&Co since October 2024, after joining as Deputy Chief Financial Officer in May 2024. Previously, he spent over 30 years at Citigroup, including serving as Treasurer from 2017 to October 2023.
people.quote: Mr. Verdeschi has served as Managing Director and Chief Financial Officer of CSC and CS&Co since October 2024.

people.name: Paul V. Woolway
people.title: Managing Director and Chief Banking Officer
people.bio: Mr. Woolway has been Managing Director of CSC since 2022 and Chief Banking Officer since 2023. He also serves as President and Chief Executive Officer of CSB, CSPB, and Trust Bank.
people.quote: Mr. Woolway has been President of CSB since 2010 and Chief Executive Officer of CSB since 2015

people.name: John K. Adams, Jr.
people.title: Director
people.bio: Former Managing Director in UBS Investment Bank's Financial Institutions Group, where he served from 2002 to 2013. Previously worked in Credit Suisse's Financial Institutions Group from 1985 to 2002.
people.quote: Mr. Adams is a former Managing Director in the Financial Institutions Group at UBS Investment Bank (UBS)

people.name: Walter W. Bettinger II
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Has served as Co-Chairman since 2022 and served as CEO from 2008 through December 2024. Joined the company in 1995 through its acquisition of The Hampton Company, which he founded in 1983.
people.quote: Mr. Bettinger has served as a member of the board since 2008 and as Co-Chairman since 2022.

people.name: Marianne C. Brown
people.title: Director and nominee
people.bio: Served as Co-COO of Fidelity National Information Services from 2018 to 2019 and previously held COO roles at FIS and SunGard. Served as CEO and President of Omgeo from 2006 to 2014.
people.quote: Ms. Brown is the former Co-COO of Fidelity National Information Services, Inc. (FIS)

people.name: Joan T. Dea
people.title: Director
people.bio: Founded Beckwith Investments LLC and has served as its Managing Director since 2008. Previously served on BMO Financial Group's Executive Committee and as a partner and director at Boston Consulting Group.
people.quote: Ms. Dea is the founder of Beckwith Investments LLC, a private investment and consulting firm

people.name: Christopher V. Dodds
people.title: Director
people.bio: Has served as Co-Founder and Managing Member of Crown Oak Advisors since 2020 and as an operating partner at The Cynosure Group since 2018. Held positions at Schwab from 1986 to 2007, including CFO from 1999 to 2007.
people.quote: Mr. Dodds has served as the Co-Founder and Managing Member of Crown Oak Advisors, LLC, a registered investment advisor, since 2020.

people.name: Stephen A. Ellis
people.title: Director
people.bio: Managing Partner at TPG, where he co-leads The Rise Fund. Previously served as CEO of Asurion from 2012 to 2015 and Worldwide Managing Director of Bain & Company from 2005 to 2012.
people.quote: Mr. Ellis is a Managing Partner at TPG Inc. (TPG), a private equity and alternative investment firm

people.name: Frank C. Herringer
people.title: Director and nominee
people.bio: Served as Chairman of Transamerica from 1996 to 2015 and CEO from 1991 to 1999. Following its acquisition by AEGON, served on AEGON's Executive Board and as Chairman of AEGON USA until 2000.
people.quote: Mr. Herringer is the former Chairman of the Board and CEO of Transamerica Corporation (Transamerica), a financial services company.

people.name: Charles A. Ruffel
people.title: Director
people.bio: Founder and Managing Partner of Kudu Investment Management. Previously served as CEO and Managing Partner of Kudu Advisors from 2009 to 2015 and as a trustee of several Schwab funds.
people.quote: Mr. Ruffel is the founder and Managing Partner of Kudu Investment Management, LLC, a private equity firm.

people.bio: Listed as a non-employee director in the 2025 Director Compensation Table and as a member of the Audit Committee.
